rv.q: By the puddle-stomping finale, resistance is futile.
This gloriously cheering new production for the Royal Exchange in Manchester is directed by Raz Shaw with visual panache and knowing wit, and is sure to be a big fat Christmas hit.
This euphoric crowd-pleaser ending a recent run of middling Christmas shows.
This revival is a sparkling festive treat in every sense, leaving a lasting impression after the final bow...
A five-star, feel-good triumph that proves some classics don’t just endure — they dance.
It was one of the most talented casts I have ever had the pleasure of watching.
The musical, a comment on fame and phoniness, leans into its aims with charm.
It was one of the happiest theatre experiences I have had, and it is no surprise the Royal Exchange has extended the run until the 25 th of January.

cn.t: Critics hail this exuberant production as pure bottled sunshine, with Shaw's vibrant staging and the iconic rain scene delighting audiences. A gloriously cheering festive treat that honors the beloved classic.
